title: The red lamp brought down
description: In a Kissing Parlor, its shopkeeper dead, the player jumps and throws a lit bomb up under the ceiling. The blast breaks the block the shop's red lamp hangs from, and the lamp falls into the crater below, a red Lamp he can carry.
